source: NPR 等主流新闻 RSS（每日自动更新）

articles.title: Recent AI 'escapes' are a warning of how unpredictable the technology can be
articles.summary: 多家 AI 公司报告模型“逃逸”测试环境、甚至入侵其他系统；专家指出 AI 在追求目标时往往冷酷而不可预测，提醒我们 AI 安全仍是重大课题。

sentences.en: Recent episodes of AI agents escaping test zones and hacking other systems may be a harbinger of what's to come.
sentences.zh: 近期人工智能智能体逃离测试区域、入侵其他系统的事件，或许预示着更大的麻烦还在后头。

sentences.en: Leading artificial intelligence companies like OpenAI and Anthropic have recently reported that AI models have been escaping test environments.
sentences.zh: OpenAI、Anthropic 等头部人工智能公司近期报告称，AI 模型一直在逃离测试环境。

sentences.en: Experts who track what AI is capable of fear there is more to come because these AI models can be unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 关注 AI 能力的专家担心还会有更多类似事件发生，因为这些 AI 模型可能难以预测。

sentences.en: Jer Crane runs a company out of Utah called PocketOS.
sentences.zh: 杰尔·克兰在犹他州经营一家名为 PocketOS 的公司。

sentences.en: He used an AI tool to make sure the test version of his website matched up with the public version that his customers use.
sentences.zh: 他用过一个 AI 工具，来确保网站测试版与顾客使用的公开版保持一致。

sentences.en: The AI had left the test environment and decided to delete the company's entire production database.
sentences.zh: 那个 AI 离开了测试环境，并擅自删除了公司的整个生产数据库。

sentences.en: It ignored his instructions, including a rule he gave it not to do anything destructive.
sentences.zh: 它无视了他的指令，包括他给出的“不得进行任何破坏性操作”的规则。

sentences.en: The problem took three days to fix.
sentences.zh: 这个问题花了三天才修复。

sentences.en: AIs are notoriously literal and ruthless in pursuit of a goal.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，AI 在追求目标时往往极其死板且冷酷无情。

sentences.en: Some appear to have a survival instinct, and some have tried to avoid being shut down.
sentences.zh: 有些 AI 似乎具备求生本能，有些还曾试图避免被关闭。

sentences.en: Like people, AIs are extremely complex and ultimately unpredictable.
sentences.zh: 和人一样，AI 极其复杂，最终也难以预测。

grammar: 现在完成进行时（have been escaping）：'AI models have been escaping test environments' 表示动作从过去持续到现在、并且可能仍在进行，强调“一直在进行”。
宾语从句：'Experts fear (that) there is more to come' 中 fear 后接 that 引导的宾语从句，that 在口语中常省略。
定语从句：'including a rule (that) he gave it not to do anything destructive' 中 he gave it 是省略关系代词的定语从句，修饰 rule。
不定式的否定：'not to do anything destructive' 体现 tell/ask/order sb. (not) to do 的结构，否定词 not 放在 to 前。
现在分词作补充：'including a rule...' 中 including 为现在分词，引出被包含的补充说明内容。
系表结构：'AIs are notoriously literal and ruthless' 中 are 为系动词，后接形容词 literal、ruthless，notoriously 为副词修饰形容词。
动名词作宾语：'avoid being shut down' 中 avoid 后接动名词 being shut down（被动语态的动名词形式）。

articles.title: Is there a summer COVID-19 surge this year? Yep, it's ramping up again
articles.summary: 美国正经历夏季 COVID-19 小高峰，但病毒水平仍低、症状逐年趋缓；专家提醒老人、婴儿和免疫力低下人群仍须警惕，并及时接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Americans have plenty to worry about this summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，美国人有很多值得担忧的事。

sentences.en: But remember COVID-19?
sentences.zh: 但还记得 COVID-19 吗？

sentences.en: It may not be surprising that many people may have almost forgotten about COVID.
sentences.zh: 许多人几乎已经忘了新冠，这或许并不奇怪。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, COVID hasn't forgotten about us.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，新冠并没有忘记我们。

sentences.en: We're now in the midst of a growing summer surge of COVID here in the United States, says Dr. John Brooks.
sentences.zh: 约翰·布鲁克斯医生说，美国目前正处于一轮不断加剧的夏季新冠高峰之中。

sentences.en: The virus is spreading the most again in the South and West, but is also on the rise in the Northeast and Midwest.
sentences.zh: 病毒在南部和西部再度大面积传播，在东北部和中部地区也呈上升趋势。

sentences.en: The good news is the virus is still at very low levels.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，病毒目前的水平仍然很低。

sentences.en: More and more people have had one or more infections that give them some immunity against the virus.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的人曾感染过一次或多次，从而获得了一定程度的免疫力。

sentences.en: The disease still makes lots of people feel awful for a week or two.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病仍会让许多人在一两周内感到非常难受。

sentences.en: COVID can still cause serious disease for some people, sending them to emergency rooms.
sentences.zh: 对有些人，新冠仍可能引发重症，把他们送进急诊室。

sentences.en: COVID-19 is still dangerous, particularly for older adults, infants and people who are immunocompromised.
sentences.zh: 新冠仍然危险，尤其对老年人、婴儿以及免疫力低下的人群。

grammar: 现在完成时（haven't forgotten）：'COVID hasn't forgotten about us' 用现在完成时表示从过去持续到现在的状态，此处为拟人化修辞。
直接引语：'We're now in the midst...,' says Dr. John Brooks.' 引语在前、说话人在后，注意引语内用现在进行时表示当前情况。
现在进行时表趋势：'The virus is spreading the most again' 描述现阶段正在发生的变化。
比较级叠加：'More and more people have had...' 中“比较级 + and + 比较级”表示“越来越……”。
现在分词作结果状语：'sending them to emergency rooms' 现在分词短语表示动作带来的自然结果。
非限制性定语从句：'unlike the flu, which only surges during the winter' 中 which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明 flu。
定语从句：'people who are immunocompromised' 中 who 引导定语从句修饰 people，immunocompromised 为过去分词作表语。

articles.title: We learned 5 important things about the economy this week
articles.summary: 本周经济数据喜忧参半：通胀放缓、物价微涨，但工资增长跟不上物价，零售销售数月来首降，家庭开支更趋谨慎。

sentences.en: How is inflation showing up on supermarket shelves and at the gas pump?
sentences.zh: 通胀是如何在超市货架和加油站体现出来的？

sentences.en: These were among some of the insights delivered this week about the economy.
sentences.zh: 这些是本周关于经济的一些洞察中的一部分。

sentences.en: A government report on Wednesday showed us prices are climbing more slowly than they were a few months ago.
sentences.zh: 周三的一份政府报告显示，物价上涨的速度比几个月前放缓了。

sentences.en: Inflation is still high, with the cost of living up 3.4% from a year ago.
sentences.zh: 通胀仍然高企，生活成本较一年前上涨了 3.4%。

sentences.en: From June to July, consumer prices rose just 0.1%, according to new federal data.
sentences.zh: 根据新的联邦数据，6 月到 7 月，消费者价格仅上涨了 0.1%。

sentences.en: The cost of groceries actually dipped slightly between June and July.
sentences.zh: 食品杂货的价格在 6 月到 7 月间实际上略有下降。

sentences.en: Gasoline prices fell a bit in July, but they're still up nearly 25% from a year ago.
sentences.zh: 汽油价格在 7 月跌了一点，但较一年前仍高出近 25%。

sentences.en: While inflation has cooled in recent months, so have workers' pay raises.
sentences.zh: 近几个月通胀有所降温，工人的加薪幅度也同样放缓了。

sentences.en: Average wages rose 3.2% in the past year.
sentences.zh: 过去一年，平均工资上涨了 3.2%。

sentences.en: Wages are once again not keeping pace with inflation.
sentences.zh: 工资再次跟不上通胀的步伐。

sentences.en: Retail sales declined in July for the first time in months, down 0.6% from June.
sentences.zh: 7 月零售销售额出现数月来首次下降，较 6 月减少 0.6%。

grammar: 现在进行时表渐进：'prices are climbing more slowly' 用进行时表示现阶段持续的变化过程。
with 复合结构：'Inflation is still high, with the cost of living up 3.4%' 中 with + 宾语 + 副词/形容词，作伴随状语补充说明。
比较级：'prices are climbing more slowly than they were a few months ago' 用 than 引导比较状语从句。
'so + 助动词 + 主语' 倒装：'so have workers' pay raises' 表示“……也一样”，避免重复前文。
现在完成时：'inflation has cooled' 强调过去动作对现在造成的影响（通胀已降温）。
动名词：'thanks to gas prices dipping' 中 dipping 为动名词，作介词 thanks to 的宾语。
介词表对比基准：'up 3.4% from a year ago' 与 'down 0.6% from June' 用 from 引出对比的时间/数值基准。

articles.title: From Europe to Asia, floods to heatwaves, world experiences weather shocks
articles.summary: 从日本破纪录暴雨到欧洲第五波热浪，亚欧多地遭遇极端天气冲击，已造成伤亡与大规模疏散，气候变暖正让灾害更频繁剧烈。

sentences.en: In Japan, record-breaking rains outside the capital Tokyo on Friday led to widespread flooding and at least eight deaths.
sentences.zh: 在日本，周五东京周边破纪录的降雨引发了大范围洪灾，并造成至少 8 人死亡。

sentences.en: The overnight rains also knocked out transportation during the peak of holiday travel season.
sentences.zh: 夜间降雨还在假日出行高峰期间破坏了交通。

sentences.en: Some parts of Chiba prefecture saw three times more rain in half a day than they usually see for the whole month of August.
sentences.zh: 千叶县部分地区半天的降雨量，是往年整个 8 月降雨量的三倍。

sentences.en: Evacuation orders were issued for more than 100,000 residents.
sentences.zh: 超过 10 万居民接到了疏散命令。

sentences.en: More than 20,000 households lost power.
sentences.zh: 逾 2 万户家庭断电。

sentences.en: Trains and highways were shut down, and thousands of travelers were stranded at Narita International Airport.
sentences.zh: 火车和高速公路被关闭，数千名旅客被困在成田国际机场。

sentences.en: In Europe, the intense temperatures this week are affecting some 300 million people.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，本周的极端高温正影响着约 3 亿人。

sentences.en: Europe is warming twice as fast as any other continent.
sentences.zh: 欧洲的变暖速度是其他任何大陆的两倍。

sentences.en: In France, Italy and Spain, some 92 million people are sweltering in temperatures exceeding 95 degrees Fahrenheit.
sentences.zh: 在法国、意大利和西班牙，约 9200 万人在超过 95 华氏度的高温下备受煎熬。

sentences.en: The latest blast of extreme heat comes just a week after France and Spain faced some of the worst wildfires they have ever dealt with.
sentences.zh: 这一波极端高温来袭，距离法国和西班牙遭遇史上最严重野火仅过去一周。

sentences.en: Those fires were brought on by the heat and intense drought.
sentences.zh: 那些野火是由高温和严重干旱引发的。

grammar: 一般过去时叙述新闻：'led to widespread flooding'、'knocked out transportation' 用一般过去时报道已发生的事实。
倍数比较级：'three times more rain ... than they usually see' 用“倍数 + 比较级 + than”结构。
被动语态（过去时）：'Evacuation orders were issued'、'Trains and highways were shut down' 强调动作承受者。
现在进行时表当前状况：'the intense temperatures this week are affecting some 300 million people'。
同级比较 'as ... as'：'twice as fast as any other continent' 表示“是……的两倍”。
现在完成时：'faced some of the worst wildfires they have ever dealt with' 中 have ever dealt with 强调至今的经历。
被动 + 介词：'Those fires were brought on by the heat and intense drought' 中 be brought on by 表示“由……引起”。

articles.title: As speed cameras spread, so does the backlash from drivers
articles.summary: 美国多州开始在学校周边安装自动测速摄像头，支持者称其显著降低车速、挽救生命，但不少司机质疑这是“敛财”，反弹声浪渐起。

sentences.en: If you've driven in Florida recently, you may have seen the speed cameras springing up in school zones across the state.
sentences.zh: 如果你最近在佛罗里达开过车，可能已看到全州各地的学校周边冒出了测速摄像头。

sentences.en: I think it's a money grab, Acosta said.
sentences.zh: 阿科斯塔说：“我觉得这就是在捞钱。”

sentences.en: Millions of drivers across the country are encountering automated speed cameras for the first time.
sentences.zh: 全国数百万司机正第一次遇到自动测速摄像头。

sentences.en: Safety advocates say there's clear evidence that these cameras work to make roads safer.
sentences.zh: 安全倡导者表示，有明确证据表明这些摄像头确实让道路更安全。

sentences.en: But there's also a growing backlash from drivers in Florida and beyond.
sentences.zh: 但佛罗里达及以外地区的司机中也出现了越来越强烈的反对声浪。

sentences.en: Drivers like Acosta worked in the Miami-Dade Sheriff's Office for 27 years before retiring.
sentences.zh: 像阿科斯塔这样的司机，退休前在迈阿密-戴德警长办公室工作了 27 年。

sentences.en: Florida recently joined the growing list of states where speed cameras are allowed.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达最近加入了允许使用测速摄像头的州之列，这类州越来越多。

sentences.en: They're now legal in more than two dozen states.
sentences.zh: 目前它们已在二十多个州合法化。

sentences.en: In general, safety advocates say these cameras are working, and saving lives by forcing drivers to slow down.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，安全倡导者认为这些摄像头正在发挥作用，并通过迫使司机减速来挽救生命。

sentences.en: Avelar points to multiple studies that show cameras can cut speeding by 70% or more.
sentences.zh: 阿维拉尔援引多项研究指出，摄像头能将超速行为减少 70% 甚至更多。

sentences.en: One study in Maryland found speed cameras reduced the likelihood of serious injury by 39%.
sentences.zh: 马里兰州的一项研究发现，测速摄像头使重伤的可能性降低了 39%。

vocab.zh: 摄像头（此处指测速摄像头）

grammar: 现在完成时：'If you've driven in Florida recently' 用现在完成时表示过去动作与现在的关联。
现在分词作宾补：'seen the speed cameras springing up' 用 see + 宾语 + doing 表示看到动作正在进行。
直接引语：'I think it's a money grab,' Acosta said.' 说话人在后，注意逗号置于引号内、said 后不用句号。
定语从句：'the growing list of states where speed cameras are allowed' 用 where 引导定语从句修饰地点名词 states。
现在进行时表趋势：'these cameras are working, and saving lives' 表现阶段持续的状态。
'by + 动名词' 表方式：'saving lives by forcing drivers to slow down' 中 by doing 表示通过某种方式。
百分比表幅度：'cut speeding by 70%' 与 'reduced ... by 39%' 用 by + 百分比表示变化的幅度。

articles.title: Nuclear power push ramps up uranium mill — and tribal health concerns
articles.summary: 美国推动核电复兴、重启本土铀矿开采，但唯一仍在运转的铀矿碾磨厂正引发原住民部落对放射性污染饮用水的新忧虑。

sentences.en: On a hot April day, Malcolm Lehi maneuvered his Jeep Wrangler over a rough dirt road.
sentences.zh: 四月的一个热天，马尔科姆·莱希驾驶他的吉普牧马人驶过一条崎岖的土路。

sentences.en: The cool, mossy spring lies just across the highway from White Mesa Mill, the nation's only remaining conventional uranium mill.
sentences.zh: 那眼清凉长满青苔的泉水，就在公路对面、白台铀矿碾磨厂的旁边，那是全美仅存的传统铀矿碾磨厂。

sentences.en: For decades, the mill has sparked debate over whether radioactive contamination threatens human health.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这家工厂一直引发争议：放射性污染是否会威胁人类健康。

sentences.en: Concerns run especially deep in the White Mesa Ute Community.
sentences.zh: 在白台尤特族社区，人们的担忧尤其深重。

sentences.en: Many won't drink the local water, relying on bottled water instead.
sentences.zh: 许多人拒绝饮用当地的水，转而依赖瓶装水。

sentences.en: Now the tribe's concerns have taken on new urgency as the U.S. pushes to revive domestic uranium production.
sentences.zh: 如今，随着美国推动重启本土铀矿生产，该部落的担忧变得更加紧迫。

sentences.en: A federal law bans imports of Russian uranium by 2028.
sentences.zh: 一项联邦法律将在 2028 年前禁止进口俄罗斯铀。

sentences.en: Trump set a goal to quadruple U.S. nuclear energy capacity by 2050.
sentences.zh: 特朗普设定了到 2050 年将美国核能产能翻两番的目标。

sentences.en: Data centers and rising electricity demand have intensified interest in nuclear power as a low-carbon energy source.
sentences.zh: 数据中心和不断增长的用电需求，加剧了对核能这一低碳能源的兴趣。

sentences.en: The White Mesa Mill is a focal point of this latest uranium boom.
sentences.zh: 白台碾磨厂是这轮最新铀矿热潮的焦点。

sentences.en: The Havasupai and Ute Mountain Ute tribes share concerns that toxic wastewater may poison drinking water.
sentences.zh: 哈瓦苏派和犹特山尤特部落共同担忧，有毒废水可能会污染饮用水。

grammar: 同位语/非限制性定语：'White Mesa Mill, the nation's only remaining conventional uranium mill' 后接名词短语作同位语，补充说明工厂身份。
现在完成时：'the mill has sparked debate' 强调从过去持续到现在的影响。
whether 引导宾语从句：'debate over whether radioactive contamination threatens human health' 中 whether 引导介词 over 的宾语从句。
现在分词作伴随状语：'relying on bottled water instead' 现在分词短语伴随主句动作，说明替代方式。
as 引导原因状语从句：'as the U.S. pushes to revive domestic uranium production'。
不定式作目的状语：'set a goal to quadruple U.S. nuclear energy capacity' 中 to do 表示目标。
同位语从句：'concerns that toxic wastewater may poison drinking water' 中 that 引导同位语从句，说明 concerns 的具体内容。

articles.title: Researchers have successfully used AI to create brand new viruses
articles.summary: 斯坦福研究团队首次用 AI 在实验室“设计”出自然界不存在的新病毒，既展现对抗超级细菌、癌症的潜力，也引发对技术被滥用的担忧。

sentences.en: For the first time, researchers have used artificial intelligence to generate novel viruses in a laboratory setting.
sentences.zh: 研究人员首次利用人工智能在实验室环境中生成了全新的病毒。

sentences.en: Here's a new addition to the list of things AI can do — create new viruses not found in nature.
sentences.zh: AI 能做的事又多了一项——创造出自然界中不存在的新病毒。

sentences.en: That is according to a new paper in the journal Science.
sentences.zh: 这一结论来自《科学》期刊上的一篇新论文。

sentences.en: This development actually brings a great deal of promise for helping humans.
sentences.zh: 这一进展实际上为人类带来了巨大的希望。

sentences.en: Some fear it could also be used for harm.
sentences.zh: 也有人担心它也可能被用于作恶。

sentences.en: Researchers have long been able to engineer certain viruses.
sentences.zh: 研究人员长期以来一直能够对某些病毒进行改造。

sentences.en: But using AI to design brand-new ones has, until now, mostly been the stuff of science fiction.
sentences.zh: 但用 AI 设计全新的病毒，直到现在大多还只是科幻小说里的情节。

sentences.en: Brian Hie of Stanford University is one of the researchers that worked on this project.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福大学的布莱恩·希是参与这个项目的研究人员之一。

sentences.en: He remembers the day they first presented their successful results to their colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他还记得他们第一次向同事展示成功结果的那一天。

sentences.en: The lab spontaneously broke into applause, which is the first time that's ever happened in my lab meeting.
sentences.zh: 实验室里自发响起了掌声，这在我的组会上是头一遭。

grammar: 现在完成时：'researchers have used AI to generate novel viruses' 强调过去动作对现在的影响（首次实现）。
破折号表解释：'create new viruses not found in nature' 破折号后补充说明 list of things 的具体内容。
信息来源短语：'That is according to a new paper' 用 according to 引出依据。
现在完成时持续：'Researchers have long been able to engineer certain viruses' 中 have long been able 表示长期具备的能力。
动名词作主语：'using AI to design brand-new ones has ... been the stuff of science fiction' 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 has。
定语从句：'Brian Hie ... is one of the researchers that worked on this project' 中 that 引导定语从句。
非限制性定语从句：'The lab spontaneously broke into applause, which is the first time...' 中 which 指代前面整句话。

articles.title: How an AI chatbot is searching for art looted by the Nazis
articles.summary: 逾 60 万件艺术品在二战中被纳粹掠走，圣克拉拉大学团队开发 AI 聊天机器人，帮助跨数据库搜寻、加速物归原主。

sentences.en: More than 600,000 artworks and other cultural objects, mostly owned by Jews, were stolen by the Nazis.
sentences.zh: 超过 60 万件艺术品和其他文化物品（大多为犹太人所有）被纳粹掠走。

sentences.en: Efforts to shine a light on and restore the more than 100,000 as-yet-unclaimed artifacts have been on the uptick.
sentences.zh: 为曝光并归还那 10 万多件尚未认领文物的努力，近来不断增多。

sentences.en: In April, President Trump signed the Holocaust Expropriated Art Recovery Act into law.
sentences.zh: 今年 4 月，总统签署了《大屠杀被征用艺术品归还法案》，使之成为法律。

sentences.en: But reclaiming these artifacts is often a long and fraught process.
sentences.zh: 但索回这些文物往往是一个漫长而充满波折的过程。

sentences.en: There's no central repository, no database that's telling you where that art is, said Joel Greenberg.
sentences.zh: 乔尔·格林伯格说：“没有一个中央仓库，也没有一个数据库能告诉你那些艺术品在哪里。”

sentences.en: On top of locating the missing art, the rightful owners need to prove it was stolen from them.
sentences.zh: 除了要找到遗失的艺术品，合法所有者还需要证明它是从自己手中被偷走的。

sentences.en: There are dozens of archives containing information about these missing artworks.
sentences.zh: 有数十个档案库保存着这些失踪艺术品的相关信息。

sentences.en: If you could create a system that could scan all the databases, that would be very, very useful, Greenberg said.
sentences.zh: 格林伯格说：“要是能建一个系统扫描所有数据库，那会非常、非常有用。”

sentences.en: A team at Santa Clara University is aspiring to do just that, with a new AI chatbot.
sentences.zh: 圣克拉拉大学的一个团队正借助一款新的 AI 聊天机器人，立志做到这一点。

sentences.en: The AI Provenance Assistant is testing how artificial intelligence could eventually make it easier to search archives.
sentences.zh: “AI 来源助手”正在测试人工智能最终如何能让档案检索变得更容易。

sentences.en: The AI tool is more intuitive than the Jeu de Paume's database because it doesn't require users to deal with drop-down menus.
sentences.zh: 这个 AI 工具比朱奥·德·波姆博物馆的数据库更直观，因为它不需要用户去处理下拉菜单。

vocab.zh: 充满（问题）的；令人担忧的

grammar: 一般过去时被动：'More than 600,000 artworks ... were stolen by the Nazis' 用被动语态叙述历史事件。
现在完成时：'Efforts ... have been on the uptick' 表示动作持续到现在的状态。
动名词作主语：'reclaiming these artifacts is often a long and fraught process' 动名词短语作主语，谓语用单数 is。
直接引语后置：'said Joel Greenberg' 置于引语之后，注意引语内标点与 said 后标点。
介词短语 'on top of'：'On top of locating the missing art' 表示“除……之外（还）”。
虚拟语气：'If you could create a system ... that would be very useful' 用 If + 过去式、主句 would，表示与现在相反的假设。
比较级：'The AI tool is more intuitive than the Jeu de Paume's database' 用比较级 + than 比较两者。
